message: "*.com" isn't a host (a host name in lowercase, like discord.com, or *. and one with a dot in it for any name under it, like *.example.com)
"Discord.com" isn't a host (a host name in lowercase, like discord.com, or *. and one with a dot in it for any name under it, like *.example.com)
"https://x.dev" is a URL: list its host alone, "x.dev", which covers http, https, ws and wss
"PlaceholderAPI" isn't a plugin's name (the plugin's name in lowercase: letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64 characters)
"with space" isn't a plugin's name (the plugin's name in lowercase: letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64 characters)
